verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API explicitly supports multiple locations with per-location settings like custom receipt text, and sellers can review/edit location info in the Dashboard; Terminal API and hardware docs support per-location device management. However, evidence lacks explicit detail on per-location reporting/analytics breakdowns or fleet-wide device provisioning workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated per-location reporting/analytics documentation, explicit multi-device fleet management tooling, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-location workflows.
